picks.title: Episode 383: Selling Out Arenas & Staying Surrendered | feat. Forrest Frank
picks.summary: This week we sit down with Christian artist Forrest Frank — live from the tour bus — to talk about what it looks like to steward massive success while keeping your heart fully surrendered to God. Forrest opens up about eight years of grinding before his breakthrough, how he stopped sneaking Jesus into his music and started giving him every breath, and why the surrendered life is available to everyone — not just the people in the arena. This one will leave you fired up!
picks.reason: Discussion of success and surrender in a Christian context, somewhat motivational.
